## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin ganz bei dir.** — [ikh bin gants by deer] — *I'm fully with you / I completely agree.*
2. **Es liegt mir am Herzen.** — [es leekt meer am HAIR-tsen] — *It's close to my heart / It matters deeply to me.*
3. **Lass es auf dich wirken.** — [lahss es owf dikh VEER-ken] — *Let it sink in / Let it work on you.*
